scenes.heading: Getting your first customers without a big marketing budget

sents.d: Getting your first customers without a big marketing budget
Local visibility and referrals typically outperform broad advertising early on.
Claiming and fully completing a free Google Business Profile is one of the highest-leverage early steps for a local service business, since many customers search directly for services 'near me.'
Asking every satisfied customer directly for a review and for referrals — rather than hoping they'll think to do it — produces both social proof and warm leads at essentially no cost.

Local community groups, neighborhood apps, and partnerships with complementary businesses (a cleaner partnering with a real estate agent, for example) often produce better early leads than broad paid advertising with no established reputation yet.

take: Complete your Google profile and ask every customer for a review.
